# Lh011 — `FileTimeStamp` not in ISO-8601 form

<!-- Auto-generated; edit `STEP_PROBLEM_CATALOG.md` instead. -->

**Section**: §12.1b (`12-1b-header`)  
**Fixture**: [`step-examples/12-1b-header/Lh011.stp`](../../step-examples/12-1b-header/Lh011.stp)  

## Sources
- 06-nist-sfa S014, 16-iso-spec N025

## Description

FILE_NAME's timestamp attribute must be ISO-8601 (`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ss[±hh:mm]`). Producers emit RFC 822 dates, locale-formatted (`27/12/2003 11:57`, `08/13/2014`), epoch integers, or empty strings.

## Reproducer recipe

`FILE_NAME('a.stp','27/12/2003 11:57',...);`

## Expected kernel behavior

lexically valid as STRING; semantic layer warns; do not block import on non-conformant timestamp.
